title: Presentarsi con precisione
summary: Use a small set of natural structures to introduce yourself and your role without overloading the first exchange.
contentNotice: Demonstration learning content for interface validation. It is not final MOSCATELLI policy, curriculum or language instruction and must be reviewed before operational use.

items: Lavoro con MOSCATELLI. — I work with MOSCATELLI.
Mi occupo di … — I am responsible for / I deal with …
Piacere di conoscerti. — Nice to meet you. (informal)
Piacere di conoscerla. — Nice to meet you. (formal)

blocks.text: Combine only the information the situation requires: name, organisation and one clear description of your role. The goal is comfortable, intelligible speech rather than a memorised biography.
